keys.beat: They land among the Lotus-eaters and send three scouts inland.
keys.text: On the tenth day we reached the land of the Lotus-eaters, who live on a food that comes from a kind of flower. Here we landed... I sent two of my company to see what manner of men the people of the place might be, and they had a third man under them.
